rule: Misha's cleanup deletes these from misha.db once they are older than shown; each other store has its own rule.

stores.description: That an event from Slack, or a worker's report, was taken in, so a repeat of it changes nothing.
How the clone closed each message it considered: replied, reacted, let it be, stayed out or failed.
The threads you're in, counted from their last message.
The threads and DMs you told the clone hands off, counted from when you said it.
Which Claude session a conversation continues, counted from its last use. Claude Code's own transcript is not part of this.
The clone's replies to each person, counted against that person's reply budget.
A message waiting for the clone never expires: it waits until it is closed, paused or not.
The record of every post, edit, upload and reaction the clone and its workers made in Slack: never deleted.

overwrittenBatches.description: What the extension installers moved aside before writing over a file in your Claude Code or OpenCode configuration, one batch per install run: the newest batches are kept and older ones deleted.
